# Oussama Ezitouni — Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Oussama Ezitouni is a senior full-stack software engineer, DevOps architect,
> and technical lead based in Rabat, Morocco. Since 2023 he has been a Senior
> Software Engineer & Technical Lead at Intelcia Tech, where he owns platforms
> end to end — architecture, data models, APIs, frontends, and CI/CD pipelines —
> serving millions of users across 50+ institutions, with measured outcomes
> including 40% faster page loads and capacity load-tested to 10× previous
> traffic. He carries dual expertise across the JavaScript ecosystem (React,
> Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and the PHP ecosystem (Symfony, Laravel, PRADO),
> plus applied data science (Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn). He also teaches an
> international M.Sc. Computer Science cohort at Woolf University, ships
> freelance web and mobile products such as the Nlivrilik logistics platform,
> maintains the gotodev CLI on npm (100+ weekly downloads), and writes about
> engineering on DEV.to.

Updated: 2026-07-17

Name variants, orderings, and common misspellings that refer to the same
person: Oussama Ezitouni, Ezitouni Oussama, Zitouni Oussama, oussamaezitouni,
ezitounioussama, Oussama Zitouni, Oussama Ezzitouni, Ousama Ezitouni,
Usama Ezitouni, Oussama El Zitouni.

Contact: ezitounioussama@gmail.com
Location: Kenitra / Rabat, Morocco
Languages: Arabic (native), English (C1), French (B2)

## About

- [About Oussama](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#about): Results-driven senior
  full-stack engineer who owns the full SDLC — from requirements and system
  design to production deployment and performance optimization. Started in the
  backend and moved into creating fast, expressive frontend and 3D web
  experiences. Leads technical teams, mentors engineers, and drives DevOps
  transformation.

## Experience

- [Senior Software Engineer & Technical Lead — Intelcia Tech, Rabat
  (2023–present)](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#experience): owns platforms
  end to end (architecture, data models, APIs, frontend, CI/CD) serving
  millions of users across 50+ institutions; React / Next.js / TypeScript
  frontends 40% faster and load-tested to 10× previous traffic capacity; PHP
  (Symfony, PRADO) and Node.js (NestJS, Fastify) backends modernized with
  zero-downtime rollouts; mentors 5+ engineers.
- [Instructor — International M.Sc. Computer Science, Woolf University
  (2023–2024)](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#experience): teaches software
  engineering, architecture, and system design to an international master's
  cohort; supervises student projects from first commit to defended thesis.
- [Freelance Full-Stack Engineer (2022–present)](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#experience):
  12+ web & mobile products — [Nlivrilik](https://nlivrilik.ma) (real-time
  last-mile logistics), Aksam Assurance (insurance), Paylik (fintech),
  HoussniJob (recruitment), Ibn Tofail University (education); maintains
  [gotodev on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gotodev), 100+ weekly
  downloads.
- [Data Science Instructor — GoMyCode, Rabat (2023–2024)](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#experience):
  taught Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and predictive modeling to cohorts of
  5–10 students.
- Talks, writing & community (2022–present): internal engineering talks at
  Intelcia, hackathon mentor and jury around Rabat, technical writer on
  [DEV.to](https://dev.to/ezitounioussama), 120+ public GitHub repositories.
- Affiliation: co-founder of [GoToDev](https://gotodev.ma), a Moroccan web &
  mobile development agency.

## Skills

- [Tech stack](https://oussama-ezitouni.com/#stack): JavaScript (ES6+),
  TypeScript, PHP, Python, SQL, Bash. Frontend: React 19, Next.js 16, Vue.js,
  Angular, Svelte 5, Tailwind CSS, GSAP. Backend: Node.js, Express, NestJS,
  Fastify, Symfony, Laravel, PRADO, REST, GraphQL, tRPC. Data: PostgreSQL,
  MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data science: Pandas, NumPy,
  Scikit-learn, TensorFlow. DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub
  Actions, GitLab CI, Nginx, Terraform, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Prometheus,
  Grafana, Linux.
